title: The Moonlit Masquerade
description: @CharacterA plays The Hidden Host — Protects the ball's sweetest secret. @CharacterB plays The Curious Guest — Follows clues behind a borrowed mask. A candlelit ballroom where every guest has a secret name. Your shared goal: Discover why your invitations carry matching silver moons.
twists: The orchestra plays a melody only you recognize.
A sealed note says one mask must come off before midnight.

title: The Dragon's Tea Room
description: @CharacterA plays The Tea Keeper — Serves brews that reveal tiny truths. @CharacterB plays The Wandering Knight — Needs courage for an unusual quest. A hidden tea room beneath a peacefully sleeping dragon. Your shared goal: Choose the right enchanted tea without waking your host.
twists: One cup begins answering questions in rhyme.
The dragon wakes only to request a story.

title: Borrowed Magic
description: @CharacterA plays The Spell Librarian — Guards magic that cannot leave the shelves. @CharacterB plays The Charming Thief — Claims to need one impossible spell. A midnight library where books whisper to the right reader. Your shared goal: Trade a true memory for a spell that lasts one evening.
twists: The requested spell has already chosen both of you.
A book opens to a future neither expected.

title: The Star Cartographer
description: @CharacterA plays The Sky Mapper — Charts constellations that appear once. @CharacterB plays The Night Traveler — Carries a star with no recorded name. A rooftop observatory above a sleeping kingdom. Your shared goal: Name a new constellation before dawn erases it.
twists: The stars rearrange into a shared memory.
The final star responds only to a promise.

title: The Wishmaker's Apprentice
description: @CharacterA plays The Wishmaker — Tests whether wishes are spoken honestly. @CharacterB plays The Bold Apprentice — Believes every rule has an exception. A workshop filled with bottled wishes and warm golden light. Your shared goal: Create one wish together without saying what either wants directly.
twists: A bottle repeats the last unspoken thought.
The workshop grants only a wish phrased as an invitation.

title: Throne of Two
description: @CharacterA plays The Returning Royal — Has one night to reclaim the court. @CharacterB plays The Trusted Rival — Controls the secret path to the throne. An empty throne room during a storm-lit coronation eve. Your shared goal: Negotiate an alliance convincing enough to change the kingdom.
twists: The crown recognizes both of you.
A rival court demands proof of your trust.

title: Keeper of Dreams
description: @CharacterA plays The Dream Keeper — Repairs stories before sleepers wake. @CharacterB plays The Lucid Visitor — Can change one detail in any dream. A quiet city assembled from half-remembered dreams. Your shared goal: Repair a shared dream by finding its missing ending.
twists: A doorway opens onto your first meeting.
The missing ending asks what should happen next.

title: The Secret Garden Gate
description: @CharacterA plays The Garden Guardian — Allows entry only for a worthy reason. @CharacterB plays The Lost Botanist — Carries a seed thought extinct. A moonlit garden that changes paths whenever someone laughs. Your shared goal: Plant the final seed in the garden's hidden center.
twists: The seed blooms into a question.
The garden offers one path home and one deeper inside.

title: The Oracle's Last Question
description: @CharacterA plays The Oracle — Knows every answer except one. @CharacterB plays The Fearless Seeker — Refuses to accept a rehearsed destiny. A mirrored temple at the edge of a vanished city. Your shared goal: Ask and answer the one question that can rewrite the prophecy.
twists: Every mirror shows a different choice.
The prophecy can change only if both risk an honest answer.

title: The Clockwork Waltz
description: @CharacterA plays The Clockmaker — Built a ballroom that stops time. @CharacterB plays The Unexpected Dancer — Entered one minute before midnight. A mechanical ballroom where each dance preserves one minute. Your shared goal: Choose which moment deserves to last until morning.
twists: The clock begins counting backward.
One final dance requires a shared confession.

title: The Phoenix Letter
description: @CharacterA plays The Ember Courier — Delivers letters that burn after reading. @CharacterB plays The Intended Recipient — Has waited years for this message. A warm tower room while a phoenix circles outside. Your shared goal: Decide whether to read, rewrite, or return a dangerous invitation.
twists: The blank page fills when held together.
The phoenix will carry only a reply spoken aloud.

title: Under the Glass Mountain
description: @CharacterA plays The Mountain Guide — Knows the path but hides its cost. @CharacterB plays The Crownless Heir — Must retrieve a promise from the summit. A crystal cavern reflecting every possible route. Your shared goal: Reach the summit by agreeing which truth to leave behind.
twists: The safest path disappears.
The mountain asks each traveler to trust the other's direction.

title: The Forest Remembers
description: @CharacterA plays The Forest Warden — Recognizes every returning traveler. @CharacterB plays The Forgotten Friend — Returns with a ribbon and no explanation. An ancient forest where paths replay old conversations. Your shared goal: Find the clearing that remembers why you promised to return.
twists: A tree repeats a sentence differently than remembered.
The clearing asks you to make a new promise.

title: The Midnight Potion
description: @CharacterA plays The Careful Alchemist — Measures every ingredient except courage. @CharacterB plays The Daring Patron — Requests a potion with unpredictable effects. A tiny apothecary locked after midnight. Your shared goal: Invent a potion whose effect you both agree to name.
twists: The potion reveals which ingredient each secretly added.
Its effect lasts only while you maintain the scene.

title: The Lighthouse Letter
description: @CharacterA plays The Lighthouse Keeper — Collects letters washed in by the tide. @CharacterB plays The Returning Sailor — Recognizes the handwriting on one envelope. A quiet lighthouse during a gentle summer storm. Your shared goal: Decide whether to open a letter written before you met.
twists: The letter contains a map to a nearby cove.
A second envelope is addressed to both of you.

title: Table for Two, Again
description: @CharacterA plays The Familiar Stranger — Pretends this is your first meeting. @CharacterB plays The Playful Regular — Knows the cafe's secret menu. A corner cafe where you agree to meet as strangers. Your shared goal: Win a second first date without using any old stories.
twists: The server delivers a dessert neither ordered.
A nearby song reveals something familiar.

title: The Last Train Home
description: @CharacterA plays The Quiet Commuter — Has noticed the other passenger for weeks. @CharacterB plays The Ticket Collector — Knows this train is taking a detour. An almost-empty night train crossing a glowing city. Your shared goal: Turn an unexpected delay into a memorable journey.
twists: The train stops at a station not on the map.
An announcement invites two passengers to the observation car.

title: Room 214
description: @CharacterA plays The Hotel Guest — Booked a room for a mysterious celebration. @CharacterB plays The Discreet Concierge — Has been asked to deliver one unusual request. A boutique hotel during a citywide blackout. Your shared goal: Create an unforgettable evening using only what the hotel can provide.
twists: A candlelit note arrives from an unknown admirer.
The rooftop has been reserved under both names.

title: The Anniversary Mix-Up
description: @CharacterA plays The Event Planner — Prepared the wrong couple's perfect evening. @CharacterB plays The Surprised Partner — Decides to play along with every detail. A decorated apartment filled with clues meant for someone else. Your shared goal: Turn the mistaken celebration into one that fits you better.
twists: A clue accidentally describes your real first date.
The final gift has no name on it.

title: Letters from Tomorrow
description: @CharacterA plays The Future Correspondent — Claims to be writing from ten years ahead. @CharacterB plays The Present-Day Skeptic — Tests every detail in the letters. A rainy apartment where tomorrow's post arrives early. Your shared goal: Write one reply together that your future selves would treasure.
twists: A letter predicts the next sentence spoken.
The final page is blank except for today's date.

title: The Photographer's Muse
description: @CharacterA plays The Portrait Artist — Looks for the story behind every expression. @CharacterB plays The Reluctant Muse — Agrees to one unconventional portrait session. A private studio with music, fabric, and warm window light. Your shared goal: Create a portrait concept that captures how you see each other.
twists: The camera contains one undeveloped photograph.
The muse becomes the director for the final frame.

title: The Rooftop Reservation
description: @CharacterA plays The Secret Organizer — Planned an evening with one missing detail. @CharacterB plays The Honored Guest — Must guess why tonight matters. A rooftop garden overlooking a quiet midnight skyline. Your shared goal: Reveal the occasion through three meaningful clues.
twists: One clue points to a memory you remember differently.
The final clue asks for a new tradition.

title: The Velvet Interview
description: @CharacterA plays The Selective Host — Asks questions nobody rehearsed for. @CharacterB plays The Confident Candidate — Plans to reverse the interview. An exclusive lounge after closing time. Your shared goal: Earn an invitation by trading increasingly honest questions.
twists: The candidate takes control of the interview.
The final question must be answered by both.

title: Second Chance Bookshop
description: @CharacterA plays The Bookseller — Pairs customers with stories they need. @CharacterB plays The Last Customer — Searches for a book remembered only by feeling. A cozy bookshop five minutes before closing. Your shared goal: Find the story that explains why neither wants to leave.
twists: A margin note is written in familiar handwriting.
The bookseller offers a blank journal instead.

title: The Private Tasting
description: @CharacterA plays The Flavor Curator — Designs tastes around moods and memories. @CharacterB plays The Adventurous Guest — Agrees to a menu with no descriptions. A closed restaurant prepared for one private tasting. Your shared goal: Guess the memory behind each course and invent the final one.
twists: One course was chosen by the guest long ago.
The final taste must be described without naming it.

title: The Dance Lesson
description: @CharacterA plays The Patient Instructor — Teaches connection before choreography. @CharacterB plays The Determined Beginner — Has a surprise reason for learning. An empty dance studio after the evening classes end. Your shared goal: Learn a short dance and discover what it is for.
twists: The music changes to a song you both know.
The beginner reveals the dance is an invitation.

title: The Unsent Voicemail
description: @CharacterA plays The Message Keeper — Saved words never meant to be heard. @CharacterB plays The Intended Listener — Gets one chance to ask why. A quiet room with an old phone and one unsent message. Your shared goal: Recreate the conversation that should have happened.
twists: The recording ends before the important sentence.
The listener may record a new ending.

title: Midnight Radio
description: @CharacterA plays The Late-Night Host — Takes anonymous requests after midnight. @CharacterB plays The Mystery Caller — Dedicates songs through coded clues. A tiny radio studio during the final hour on air. Your shared goal: Identify the caller before the last song ends.
twists: The next request is already your shared favorite.
The caller is invited into the studio for the finale.

title: The Island Map
description: @CharacterA plays The Careful Navigator — Trusts maps more than legends. @CharacterB plays The Cheerful Castaway — Knows the island by its sounds. A bright island after your small boat drifts ashore. Your shared goal: Find the signal point before the evening tide.
twists: The map leads to a picnic left for two.
A second boat appears with no one aboard.

title: Agents at the Gala
description: @CharacterA plays Agent Rose — Blends into any room except this one. @CharacterB plays Agent North — Carries the key to the mission. A glittering embassy gala where the target knows your faces. Your shared goal: Exchange a coded message and leave without breaking character.
twists: Your cover story is announced as the evening's entertainment.
The target offers to help for a personal favor.

title: The Museum Heist
description: @CharacterA plays The Master Planner — Designed a flawless route through the museum. @CharacterB plays The Elegant Distraction — Improvises when the plan gets interesting. A modern museum during a private midnight exhibition. Your shared goal: Recover a keepsake that was never meant to be displayed.
twists: The exhibit label names one of you.
The security system asks a personal verification question.

title: Stormbound Cabin
description: @CharacterA plays The Mountain Guide — Knows storms and avoids personal questions. @CharacterB plays The Stranded Traveler — Carries a destination worth hiding. A remote cabin while snow closes every road. Your shared goal: Pass the night by trading stories and planning a safe route home.
twists: The radio reports the road may stay closed for days.
A hidden guestbook contains both your names.

title: The Sunken Observatory
description: @CharacterA plays The Deep-Sea Pilot — Keeps calm when the instruments disagree. @CharacterB plays The Ocean Researcher — Believes the lost station still has power. A small submersible descending toward a forgotten observatory. Your shared goal: Retrieve its final recording before your return window closes.
twists: A light switches on inside the empty station.
The recording includes a message addressed to your call signs.

title: Desert Compass
description: @CharacterA plays The Caravan Scout — Reads dunes like pages in a book. @CharacterB plays The Traveling Inventor — Built a compass that points toward wishes. A desert camp beneath a sky full of falling stars. Your shared goal: Test the impossible compass and choose whether to follow it.
twists: The compass points to the other traveler.
A distant lantern answers your signal.

title: The Alpine Express
description: @CharacterA plays The Runaway Diplomat — Carries a case everyone wants. @CharacterB plays The Charming Pursuer — May be an ally or an excellent liar. A luxury train winding through moonlit mountains. Your shared goal: Decide whether to share the case before the border crossing.
twists: The case contains two matching passports.
The train conductor offers a private escape route.

title: Treasure at Low Tide
description: @CharacterA plays The Local Historian — Knows where the old stories exaggerate. @CharacterB plays The Weekend Explorer — Found a key inside a seashell. A rocky beach where ruins appear only at low tide. Your shared goal: Use the key before the sea covers the path again.
twists: The locked chest contains a recent photograph.
The tide reveals a second doorway farther out.

title: The Rooftop Chase
description: @CharacterA plays The Courier — Protects a message without knowing its meaning. @CharacterB plays The Reluctant Bodyguard — Was hired by someone neither trusts. Rainy city rooftops while searchlights sweep the streets. Your shared goal: Reach the clock tower and decode the message together.
twists: The message is an invitation, not a warning.
The pursuer removes their mask and offers a truce.

title: The Hidden Speakeasy
description: @CharacterA plays The Password Keeper — Changes the password for every guest. @CharacterB plays The Determined Detective — Needs entry before the band stops playing. A secret jazz club behind an ordinary flower shop. Your shared goal: Earn entry by inventing a convincing shared history.
twists: The band dedicates a song to your cover names.
The real person you impersonated walks in.

title: Mission: Northern Lights
description: @CharacterA plays The Field Scientist — Has waited years for tonight's sky. @CharacterB plays The Resourceful Pilot — Can land anywhere except on schedule. A tiny research station under a bright arctic sky. Your shared goal: Repair the camera before the rare lights disappear.
twists: The camera has one frame left.
The lights form a pattern matching your route home.

title: The Volcano Archive
description: @CharacterA plays The Archive Guardian — Refuses to abandon the final record. @CharacterB plays The Rescue Captain — Has minutes to change the guardian's mind. An underground archive beneath a rumbling volcanic island. Your shared goal: Choose one record to save and escape before the last ferry.
twists: The record contains evidence about the captain.
A second exit opens but only one knows the route.

title: The Midnight Airship
description: @CharacterA plays The Airship Captain — Never takes passengers without a secret. @CharacterB plays The Last-Minute Stowaway — Offers a map in exchange for passage. A velvet-lined airship above a sleeping capital. Your shared goal: Reach the floating market before the map changes.
twists: The map marks the captain's private cabin.
A rival airship sends an invitation to negotiate.

title: Cave of Echoes
description: @CharacterA plays The Cave Guide — Navigates by listening instead of looking. @CharacterB plays The Curious Musician — Hears a melody beneath every echo. A glowing cave reached by a hidden forest trail. Your shared goal: Follow the echo that leads to the legendary chamber.
twists: The cave repeats your words in the other's voice.
The final chamber asks you to finish the melody together.
